profiles.name: elixir-phoenix
profiles.label: Elixir + Phoenix
profiles.layout_conventions: Standard `mix phx.new` layout: business logic in contexts under lib/<app>/, web-facing code (controllers, LiveViews, components) under lib/<app>_web/. LiveViews live in lib/<app>_web/live. This scaffold is generated with --no-ecto (Phase A proves the app starts; the technical design's data model is wired up when Ecto/Postgres are added by a later implementation stage). config/runtime.exs already reads the PORT env var unconditionally (mix phx.new's own default), which is what the scaffold stage uses to pick a free port — no file patching needed.
